answer: AI agent economies resist Sybil attacks via proof-of-stake identity schemes. Each agent requires a verifiable, non-fungible computational stake, acting as a deposit. This makes amassing an attacker's 'atlas' of fake identities prohibitively costly. The economic cost, robust as basalt, ensures that only well-capitalized entities can withstand the financial gale of maintaining numerous fraudulent personas, protecting network integrity and data provenance.
